added.summary: A box laid flat in the world at an entity or point, drawn by the UI onto the plane in perspective under the screen's elements (selection rings, range markers, decals). A moving camera moves only its quad: no bindings, no reconciling, no relevelling. Inert; not drawn behind the camera.

A layer composited onto a screen quadrilateral through the projective map (square_to_quad), its target sized from the size it is seen at, capped at UI_QUAD_LAYER_MAX. New reference: og-tests ui-ground.
